Dhika saw some food spilled in the place they ate and decided to clean it. She went inside her bedroom to fetch cloth from bathroom.
As she was in the bathroom, she looked herself in the mirror.
Dhika: Chotu too thinks me as beautiful. am I really still beautiful after having one kid....

Suddenly she remembered her yesterday's bending down and her thoughts at night. Unknown to her, something took over her and she felt very very excited. Not knowing what happened next, she removed her dupatta slowly and looked at herself in mirror.

She looked at her own body. It was a deep cut dress and she could see her own cleavage. She felt unknown excitement and bit her lip and smiler herself blushingly. Her white skin was shining against black sleeveless dress.

Suddenly a thought came to her mind. She wasn't sure if Chotu saw inside her dress yesterday and she felt a great urge to find if he would see. This was not her.... she has never done anything like this and she didn't know what to do.
Without an answer for her thoughts, she just took a waste cloth and went to hall without Dupatta.......
As soon as she entered the hall, Chotu saw that she did not wear dupatta but he simply thought she missed and kept it in bedroom or bathroom. He was sitting exactly opposite to her.

Dhika felt very nervous and excited at the same time...... she was going to be openly showing her cleavage first time in her life(  outside her husband) and she couldn't understand what is driving her. Her thoughts were so clouded due to excitement.
Without thinking much she bent down..... got on all fours and began wiping the floor.

Dhika was very very nervous and didn't dare to look up and at Chotu... She kept wiping the floor for next 1 minute and meanwhile Chotu was still wide eyed and having the time of his life.
After a minutes, Dhika mustered all the courage she could and she looked in the direction of Chotu.
Their eyes met.
Chotu wide eyed and Dhika with excitement and nervousness in eyes. She was biting her lips very subtly.
In a second Chotu stood up and took the money she gave earlier and left with a bye which sounded from very far.

Dhika could not believe what she just did and still feeling very excited, she dropped the cloth on the floor and from the position of all fours, she just flipped and dropped on her back, laying down....then and there on the floor.
She covered her face with all excitement and blushing and shyness and this time she felt a tingle ...... not down her spine but .... down there in-between her legs
